old_problem: The source omits the PDB contract that maps I2C responders and registers to physical rails/channels. DeepSeek's global scan cannot distinguish telemetry from control/limit/latch endpoints, does not prove PSU-to-PDB topology or units/scaling, and can expose the whole SUT power domain to unbounded probes.
disposition_reason: Retain Pending and BLOCKED. A PDB response is meaningful only with a board-revision route, physical rail/channel map, register units/scaling and expected ranges. The same endpoint may expose observation and power-control functions. These are core target, safety and PASS semantics, not values that a generic package or runtime parameter can invent.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1804, same-row DeepSeek/test-json, GPT V2, historical record, pending/blocked analyses and ED-01 through ED-30 were read. The next formal locked-queue identity was directly opened as Functionality row 1805 / Wistron-HW-00007-V003 / 528461acfa38307e.
PDB_BD I2C defaults to BMC/platform-management scope and requires an explicit controller/mux/address and per-channel register map.
An address grid cannot prove physical input/output rail mapping, measurement scaling, redundancy behavior or unchanged distribution state.
ED-03 forbids guessed OEM paths/registers and ED-15 forbids PASS without approved voltage/current/power/temperature and redundancy criteria.
Because PDB control and telemetry may share a device, generic i2cdetect probing cannot be presumed harmless in the whole-system power domain.
No SSH, I2C, PDB, PSU, power, scan, write, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

safety_gate: Do not access PDB buses until board revision, rail/channel topology and register-level read allowlist are approved.
Prohibit generic scans and all control, limit, latch, clear, write, force or vendor-unknown transactions.
Verify stable PSU/load/redundancy and preserve synchronized PDB/PSU/BMC and independent evidence.
Stop on any rail, telemetry, redundancy, management or bus anomaly; do not retry, reset or power-cycle automatically.
expected_evidence: Approved PDB specification, revision and PSU/rail/channel topology
Controller/mux/bus/address/register allowlist, exclusions, units/scaling and tool/session identity
Complete per-channel raw and converted telemetry mapped to physical rails
Synchronized PSU, BMC SDR/SEL, load/redundancy and independent-measurement baselines/deltas
Abort/no-retry/independent-power-recovery audit and power/platform owner verdict
test_case.recovery: No access or recovery action is authorized now. In a future approved run, stop at the first power or management anomaly, preserve complete evidence and do not retry. Use an independent console/BMC/power recovery path; bus reset, PDB/PSU reset, failover, reboot or power cycle requires an explicit separate procedure and authorization.
